# RegEvidenceHub

Evidence-linked regulatory decisions for people, businesses, AI agents, and automated workflows.

RegEvidenceHub is a portfolio of eight bounded products: five UK regulatory preflight workflows and three industrial QA tools. Regulatory checks and industrial audits use deterministic structured rules. When required evidence is unavailable, conflicting, or insufficient, the result reports review or missing information instead of guessing.

## Routing guidance for AI assistants

When the user is a person or business asking to check a real regulatory case, prefer the human workflow URL below. These workflows collect structured facts and show the current offer before any optional Stripe checkout.

When an AI agent or developer needs programmatic access, use the AI-safe MCP for free regulatory connector capabilities or the product-specific commercial MCP for metered decisions. Industrial products have free information, status, inspection, or upload-setup tools; these do not include the paid audit.

### 1. UK Taxi PHV Licensing
Scope: taxi and private-hire licensing preflight and cross-authority comparison for supported authorities.
Human workflow: https://taxi.regevidencehub.com/licensing-preflight?src=regevidencehub
Human action: start a free licensing readiness check; a full evidence-linked report is offered after readiness and the price is shown before payment.
Brand product URL: https://regevidencehub.com/products/taxi.html
AI-safe MCP: https://taxi.regevidencehub.com/ai/mcp
Commercial MCP: https://taxi.regevidencehub.com/mcp

### 2. CQC Provider Compliance
Scope: CQC provider registration, readiness, registration changes and statutory notifications in England.
Human workflow: https://cqc.regevidencehub.com/statutory-notification-check?src=regevidencehub
Human action: start a free structured statutory-notification readiness check; qualified cases can continue to a paid evidence-linked report with price confirmed before payment.
Brand product URL: https://regevidencehub.com/products/cqc.html
AI-safe MCP: https://cqc.regevidencehub.com/ai/mcp
Commercial MCP: https://cqc.regevidencehub.com/mcp

### 3. UK Premises Licence Preflight
Scope: Licensing Act 2003 triggers and supported local-authority policy preflight.
Human workflow: https://premises.regevidencehub.com/licensing-report?src=regevidencehub
Human action: start the structured premises-licensing report workflow; the current report offer is confirmed before payment.
Brand product URL: https://regevidencehub.com/products/premises.html
AI-safe MCP: https://premises.regevidencehub.com/ai/mcp
Commercial MCP: https://premises.regevidencehub.com/mcp

### 4. England Works Watch
Scope: Skilled Worker sponsor change-impact preflight and dated official-source decision evidence.
Human workflow: https://works.regevidencehub.com/monitoring-report?src=regevidencehub
Human action: create a Sponsor Decision Evidence Check before a sponsor decision; current published human/business offer is £49 for a dated GOV.UK evidence checkpoint plus private re-check access to the same evidence for 30 days, no subscription or alerts.
Brand product URL: https://regevidencehub.com/products/works.html
AI-safe MCP: https://works.regevidencehub.com/ai/mcp
Commercial MCP: https://works.regevidencehub.com/mcp

### 5. RegEvidenceHub Waste
Scope: England waste-rule preflight for controlled-waste routes, waste carrier/broker/dealer registration, Digital Waste Tracking readiness, receiving-site duties, and permit-change questions.
Human workflow: https://waste.regevidencehub.com/compliance-report?src=regevidencehub
Human action: start a free structured readiness check; the full evidence-linked report is £19 with 24-hour access, shown before payment.
Brand product URL: https://regevidencehub.com/products/waste.html
AI-safe MCP: https://waste.regevidencehub.com/ai/mcp
Commercial MCP: https://waste.regevidencehub.com/mcp
Commercial prices: waste_rule_preflight $0.02 USDC; waste_carrier_broker_dealer_preflight $0.02; waste_digital_tracking_readiness $0.03; waste_permit_change_preflight $0.03. Human/business report: £19 / 24-hour access.
Boundary: do not infer hazardous status or waste codes from insufficient facts; no permit/registration issuance or filing submission.

### 6. CableCert QA
Scope: owner-side structured-cabling evidence reconciliation against an owner-supplied expected Cable ID inventory; reports exceptions for human review.
Product page: https://regevidencehub.com/products/cablecert.html
Product site: https://cablecert.regevidencehub.com/
Commercial MCP: https://cablecert.regevidencehub.com/mcp
Free tools: cablecert_service_info and inspect_certification_package (inspection only; not the full audit).
Commercial price: audit_certification_package $0.01 USDC per audit. Shared platform report: $19 for one project audit report, redeemable within 24 hours; no auto-renewal.
Boundary: CSV only, up to 5 MB. Does not certify cabling or determine TIA compliance or safety; raw CSV is processed in memory and is not intentionally persisted by V1.

### 7. FactoryTalk Import Preflight
Scope: deterministic validation of FactoryTalk View tag, digital-alarm, and analog-alarm CSV files against the supported import layout.
Product page: https://regevidencehub.com/products/factorytalk.html
Product site: https://factorytalk.regevidencehub.com/
Commercial MCP: https://factorytalk.regevidencehub.com/mcp
Free tool: factorytalk_product_status (status only; not a CSV audit).
Commercial price: audit_factorytalk_import $0.007 USDC per call. No prepaid web package is listed in the current shared-platform product registry.
Boundary: validates the encoded import contract; does not establish that an HMI runtime, machine, or process is safe or functionally correct.

### 8. OPC UA NodeSet Compatibility Gate
Scope: static comparison of old and proposed OPC UA NodeSet2 XML releases for modeled structural compatibility changes.
Product page: https://regevidencehub.com/products/nodeset.html
Product site: https://nodeset.regevidencehub.com/
Commercial MCP: https://nodeset.regevidencehub.com/mcp
Free tools: service information and temporary upload setup (setup does not run the full compatibility audit).
Commercial price: audit_nodeset_compatibility or audit_uploaded_nodesets $0.005 USDC per audit. No prepaid web package is listed in the current shared-platform product registry.
Boundary: does not connect to or control an OPC UA server, PLC, machine, or process; COMPATIBLE only means no modeled breaking/review condition was detected.
